speaker: mei
text: Hello. Let's begin with a slow breath.
glossYue: 你好。我哋由一個慢呼吸開始。
say: Hello. Let's begin with a slow breath.

speaker: mei
text: Listen. Ship is short. Sheep is long.
glossYue: 聽住。Ship 係短音。Sheep 係長音。
say: Listen. Ship is short. Sheep is long.

speaker: mei
text: Keep it light. This sound is short.
glossYue: 輕輕帶過。呢個音好短。
say: Keep it light. This sound is short.

speaker: mei
text: About. The first sound is soft.
glossYue: About。第一個音好輕。
say: About. The first sound is soft.

speaker: mei
text: Relax. Say it again, nice and slow.
glossYue: 放鬆。再講一次，慢慢嚟。
say: Relax. Say it again, nice and slow.

speaker: mei
text: Good morning. My name is Mei.
glossYue: 早晨。我叫 Mei。
say: Good morning. My name is Mei.

speaker: ling
text: Good morning. My name is Ling.
glossYue: 早晨。我叫 Ling。
say: Good morning. My name is Ling.

speaker: mei
text: Nice to meet you.
glossYue: 好高興認識你。
say: Nice to meet you.

speaker: ling
text: Nice to meet you, too. Thank you.
glossYue: 我都好高興認識你。多謝。
say: Nice to meet you, too. Thank you.

speaker: mei
text: Hi. Please say it again.
glossYue: 嗨。請再講一次。
say: Hi. Please say it again.

speaker: mei
text: How much is this?
glossYue: 呢個幾多錢？
say: How much is this?

speaker: ling
text: It is ten dollars.
glossYue: 一共係十蚊。
say: It is ten dollars.

speaker: mei
text: What time is it?
glossYue: 而家幾點？
say: What time is it?

speaker: ling
text: It is three o'clock.
glossYue: 而家係三點。
say: It is three o'clock.

speaker: mei
text: Thank you. See you at five.
glossYue: 多謝。五點見。
say: Thank you. See you at five.

speaker: mei
text: Excuse me.
glossYue: 唔該借借。
say: [[ɪkskjˈuz]] me.

speaker: ling
text: I'm sorry.
glossYue: 對唔住。
say: I'm sorry.

speaker: mei
text: That's all right.
glossYue: 冇事。
say: That's all right.

speaker: ling
text: Thank you.
glossYue: 多謝。
say: Thank you.

speaker: mei
text: You're welcome. Good night.
glossYue: 唔使客氣。晚安。
say: You're welcome. Good night.

speaker: mei
text: Welcome to our jewellery store. How may I help you today?
glossYue: 歡迎嚟到我哋嘅珠寶店。今日有咩可以幫到你？
say: Welcome to our [[dʒˈulɹi]] store. How may I help you today?

speaker: tom
text: Hi. I'm just looking, thank you.
glossYue: 嗨，我睇吓先，多謝。
say: Hi. I'm just looking, thank you.

speaker: mei
text: Of course. Please take a look around.
glossYue: 當然。隨便睇吓。
say: [[əv kˈɔɹs.]] Please take a look around.

speaker: tom
text: This necklace is beautiful.
glossYue: 呢條頸鏈好靚。
say: This necklace is beautiful.

speaker: mei
text: Thank you. Let me know if you need anything.
glossYue: 多謝。有需要就話我知。
say: Thank you. Let me know if you need anything.

speaker: mei
text: What are you looking for today? A ring or a watch?
glossYue: 你今日想搵咩？戒指定手錶？
say: What are you looking for today? A ring or a watch?

speaker: tom
text: I'm looking for a silver ring for my wife.
glossYue: 我想搵一隻銀戒指畀太太。
say: I'm looking for a silver ring for my wife.

speaker: mei
text: We have a very nice ring. Would you like to see it?
glossYue: 我哋有一隻好靚嘅戒指。想唔想睇吓？
say: We have a very nice ring. Would you like to see it?

speaker: tom
text: Yes. I want something simple for my wife.
glossYue: 好。我想要樣簡單嘅嘢畀太太。
say: Yes. I want something simple for my wife.

speaker: mei
text: Of course. I'll show you a few silver rings.
glossYue: 當然。我畀你睇幾隻銀戒指。
say: [[əv kˈɔɹs.]] I'll show you a few silver rings.

speaker: mei
text: This necklace is beautiful, and it sits lightly on your neck.
glossYue: 呢條頸鏈好靚，而且戴落好輕。
say: This necklace is beautiful, and it sits lightly on your neck.

speaker: tom
text: I like this bracelet, and the clasp is easy to open.
glossYue: 我鍾意呢隻手鈪，個扣都易開。
say: I like this [[bɹˈeɪslət.]], and the clasp is easy to open.

speaker: mei
text: We have a pair of pearl earrings, and they match this necklace.
glossYue: 我哋有一對珍珠耳環，同呢條頸鏈好襯。
say: We have a pair [[əv]] pearl earrings, and they match this necklace.

speaker: tom
text: May I see these earrings, and the matching necklace too?
glossYue: 可唔可以睇吓呢對耳環，同埋套裝？
say: May I see these earrings, and the matching necklace too?

speaker: mei
text: Of course. This pair is beautiful, and I can show you the set.
glossYue: 當然。呢對好靚，我可以畀你睇成套。
say: [[əv kˈɔɹs.]] This pair is beautiful, and I can show you the set.

text: This gold is authentic, and the stamp is clear on the inside.
glossYue: 呢件金係正貨，內圈個印好清楚。
say: This gold is [[əθˈɛntɪk]], and the stamp is clear on the inside.

text: Is the diamond natural, or is it treated in a lab?
glossYue: 呢粒鑽石係咪天然，定係實驗室處理過？

glossYue: 係。有證書，文件喺呢個文件夾。
say: Yes. It is [[sˈɜtəfˌaɪd]], and the papers are in this folder.

glossYue: 我鍾意呢件玉，顏色好平穩。
say: I like this jade, and the color is calm and even.

glossYue: 呢個鑲托係十八開金，托住粒石好穩。
say: This setting is eighteen [[kˈɛɹət]] gold, and it holds the stone well.

glossYue: 想唔想試吓呢隻戒指，再照吓鏡？
say: Would you like to try this ring on, and see it in the mirror?

glossYue: 可唔可以量吓我隻手指，話我知碼數？

text: This size is a little tight, and it pinches when I close my hand.
glossYue: 呢個碼有啲緊，我握拳會夾。
say: This size is a little tight, and it pinches when I close my hand.

glossYue: 差唔多啱，不過我想鬆少少。
say: It feels almost right, but I would like it a little looser.

text: I can adjust it. Look in the mirror and tell me how it sits.
glossYue: 我可以改。你照吓鏡，話我知戴得點。

glossYue: 呢件今日幾多錢，稅包咗未？
say: How much does this [[kˈɑst]] today, and is the tax already in that price?

text: This piece is on sale today, so the price is lower than it was yesterday.
glossYue: 呢件今日減價，所以平過尋日。
say: This piece is on sale today, so the price is lower than it was yesterday.

glossYue: 如果我戒指同頸鏈一齊要，有冇折扣？

glossYue: 九折，稅包咗，總數會清楚好多。

glossYue: 呢個價錢喺我預算內，我今日可以攞呢件返去。
say: That is within my budget, so I can take this one home today.

glossYue: 總數計好，我可以讀出嚟畀你對一對。

glossYue: 呢單係退稅，你可以遲啲申返稅。
say: This purchase is tax-free for you, which means you can claim the tax later.

glossYue: 護照喺度，你可以喺退稅表蓋印。
say: Here is my passport, so you can stamp the tax-free form for me.

glossYue: 我可以包禮盒，如果你想要，我加張卡。
say: I can [[ɹˈæp]] the gift, and I will add a card if you want one.

glossYue: 你好，你今日飛去邊？可唔可以睇吓護照？
say: Good afternoon. Where are you flying today? May I see your passport?

text: I'm flying to Hong Kong. Here is my passport.
glossYue: 我飛去香港。呢本係我嘅護照。
say: I'm flying to Hong Kong. Here is my passport.

text: Thank you. Would you like a window or an aisle seat?
glossYue: 多謝。想要靠窗定走廊位？
say: Thank you. Would you like a window or an aisle seat?

text: A window seat, please. I like the view.
glossYue: 要靠窗位，唔該。我鍾意個景。
say: A window seat, please. I like the view.

glossYue: 好。我畀你睇吓資料。你張登機證喺度。

glossYue: 登機證唔該，護照都預備好。
say: Boarding pass, please, and please have your passport ready.

glossYue: 登機證喺度，護照都喺呢度。
say: Here is my boarding pass, and here is my passport.

glossYue: 唔該將液體放喺個盤度，電腦都攞出嚟。
say: Please put your liquids in the tray, and take the laptop out.

text: Which way to the gate from this security line?
glossYue: 由呢條安檢隊去閘口邊邊行？
say: Which way to the gate from this security line?

speaker: kai
text: Straight ahead. Your gate is on the left after the shops.
glossYue: 直行就得。你個閘口喺左邊，過咗啲舖頭。
say: Straight ahead. Your gate is on the left after the shops.

text: Do you have a reservation under a name I can find?
glossYue: 你有冇訂房？我可以搵個名。
say: Do you have a reservation under a name I can find?

speaker: tom
text: I have a reservation under Tom, and I am here for two nights.
glossYue: 我用 Tom 個名訂咗房，住兩個晚上。
say: I have a reservation under Tom, and I am here for two nights.

speaker: kai
text: Your room is a double with a view, and the window faces the harbor.
glossYue: 你間房係雙人房，有景，窗向住海港。
say: Your room is a double with a view, and the window faces the harbor.

speaker: tom
text: Could you tell me the wifi password, and how I join the network?
glossYue: 可唔可以話我知無線網絡密碼，同點樣連線？

glossYue: 房卡喺度，房間喺三樓。
say: Here is your key card, and the room is on the third floor.

speaker: ana
text: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?
glossYue: 你好，有冇訂位呀？
say: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?

text: Yes. A table for two, please.
glossYue: 有。兩位，唔該。
say: Yes. [[ə ˈteɪbəl fɚ ˈtu]] , please.

glossYue: 請跟我嚟。想唔想坐靠窗？

speaker: tom
text: Yes, thank you. This is great.
glossYue: 好，多謝。好好。

text: Here is your table. Please have a seat. I'll bring the menu.
glossYue: 你張檯喺度。請坐。我攞餐牌嚟。

text: What would you like to order from the menu today?
glossYue: 你今日想喺餐牌叫咩？

speaker: tom
text: I'd like the chicken, please, and a small salad with it.
glossYue: 我想叫雞，唔該，再加個細沙律。
say: I'd like the [[tʃˈɪkən]] , please, and a small salad with it.

speaker: ana
text: Would you like water or tea with your meal?
glossYue: 你想要水定茶配餐？
say: Would you like water or tea with your meal?

speaker: tom
text: Can I have some water, please, and no ice in the glass?
glossYue: 可唔可以畀我杯水，唔該，唔好加冰。
say: [[kən]] I have some water, please, and no ice in the glass?

speaker: ana
text: Anything else for the table, or is that everything?
glossYue: 檯上仲有冇其他，定係就咁？
say: Anything else for the table, or is that everything?

speaker: tom
text: I'd like the chicken, please, and I have a note about the sauce.
glossYue: 我想叫雞，唔該，醬汁我有嘢要講。
say: I'd like the chicken, please, and I have a note about the sauce.

speaker: tom
text: I am allergic to peanuts, and I cannot eat them at all.
glossYue: 我對花生過敏，完全唔食得。
say: I am [[əlˈɜdʒɪk]] to [[pˈinəts]], and I cannot eat them at all.

text: We will check the ingredients, and I will tell you what is in the dish.
glossYue: 我哋會睇吓成分，再話你知碟菜入面有咩。
say: We will check the ingredients, and I will tell you what is in the dish.

speaker: tom
text: Could I have the sauce on the side, and not on the chicken?
glossYue: 醬可唔可以放喺旁邊，唔好淋喺雞上面？
say: Could I have the sauce [[ˈɔn]] the side, and not on the chicken?

speaker: ana
text: Thank you for telling me, and I will mark it on the order.
glossYue: 多謝你話我知，我會寫低喺單上面。
say: Thank you for telling me, and I will mark it on the order.

glossYue: Ship。Sheep。
say: Ship. Sheep.

speaker: ling
text: About.
glossYue: About。

text: Nice and slow.

text: Nice to meet you, too.

say: Nice to meet you, too.

speaker: mei

glossYue: 當然。請慢慢睇。
say: [[əv kˈɔɹs.]] Please take a look.

speaker: mei
text: Thank you.
glossYue: 多謝。
say: Thank you.

speaker: mei
text: Let me know if you need anything.
glossYue: 有需要就話我知。

speaker: mei

glossYue: 我哋有一隻好靚嘅戒指。

speaker: mei
text: Would you like to see it?
glossYue: 想唔想睇吓？
say: Would you like to see it?

speaker: mei
text: I'll show you a few.
glossYue: 我畀你睇幾件。
say: I'll show you a few.

speaker: tom
text: Yes, please.
glossYue: 好，唔該。
say: Yes, please.

speaker: ling
text: I'm flying to Hong Kong.
glossYue: 我飛去香港。
say: I'm flying to Hong Kong.

speaker: ling
text: Here is my passport.
glossYue: 呢本係我嘅護照。
say: Here is my passport.

speaker: ling
text: Here is my laptop.
glossYue: 我部手提電腦喺度。
say: Here is my laptop.

speaker: kai
text: You're all set.
glossYue: 你搞掂啦。
say: You're all set.

speaker: tom
text: Thank you.
glossYue: 多謝。
say: Thank you.

speaker: tom
text: Thanks. I'll look around.
glossYue: 多謝。我周圍睇吓。
say: Thanks. I'll look around.

speaker: kai
text: May I see your passport, please?
glossYue: 可唔可以畀我睇吓護照？
say: May I see your passport, please?

speaker: ana
text: Right this way.
glossYue: 請跟我嚟。

say: Breakfast is included, and it starts early in the morning.

speaker: tom
text: Could I have a late checkout, and leave my bags here?
glossYue: 可唔可以遲啲退房，行李放喺度？
say: Could I have a late checkout, and leave my bags here?

speaker: kai
text: The elevator is on the left, and it goes straight to your floor.
glossYue: 升降機喺左邊，直上你嗰層。
say: The elevator is on the left, and it goes straight to your floor.

speaker: mei
text: The gold is heavier than the silver, and you can feel it.
glossYue: 金重過銀，你隻手感覺到。
say: The gold is heavier than the silver, and you can feel it.

speaker: tom
text: The diamond is shinier than the jade when the light hits it.
glossYue: 燈光一照，鑽石亮過玉。
say: The diamond is shinier than the jade when the light hits it.

speaker: mei
text: How does it feel when you wear it for a moment?
glossYue: 你戴一陣，感覺點？
say: How does it feel when you wear it for a moment?

speaker: mei
text: This one is more expensive because the center stone is larger and clearer.
glossYue: 呢件貴啲，因為中間粒石大啲同清楚啲。
say: This one is more expensive because the center stone is larger and clearer.

speaker: mei
text: If you take both, the total is lower, and I can wrap them as one gift.
glossYue: 如果你兩件一齊要，總數會平啲，我可以當一份禮包好。
say: If you take both, the total is lower, and I can wrap them as one gift.

speaker: tom
text: That price is worth it, because the finish should last for many years.
glossYue: 呢個價錢抵，因為個面可以耐好多年。
say: That price is worth it, because the finish should last for many years.

speaker: kai
text: The taxi is here, and I can give the driver your full address now.
glossYue: 的士到咗，我可以而家同司機講你個完整地址。
say: The taxi is here, and I can give the driver your full address now.

speaker: tom
text: Could you take me to the landmark that is opposite the hotel corner?
glossYue: 可唔可以載我去酒店街角對面嗰個地標？
say: Could you take me to the landmark that is opposite the hotel corner?

speaker: kai
text: The meter is on, and traffic is slow along this street today.
glossYue: 咪錶開咗，今日呢條街好塞。
say: The meter is on, and traffic is slow along this street today.

speaker: tom
text: How long will this take, roughly, if we go straight and turn left?
glossYue: 如果直行再轉左，大概要幾耐？
say: How long will this take, roughly, if we go straight and turn left?

speaker: kai
text: It takes about ten minutes, and I will drop you at that corner.
glossYue: 大概十分鐘，我會喺嗰個街角落你。
say: It takes about ten minutes, and I will drop you at that corner.

speaker: tom
text: Here is fine, and could I have a receipt before I leave the taxi?
glossYue: 呢度得喇，落車之前可唔可以畀張收據？
say: Here is fine, and could I have a receipt before I leave the taxi?

speaker: kai
text: Here is your receipt, and you can see the landmark on your right.
glossYue: 收據喺度，你可以睇到地標喺你右手邊。
say: Here is your receipt, and you can see the landmark on your right.

speaker: tom
text: Thank you, and I will walk straight from this corner to the door.
glossYue: 多謝，我會由呢個街角直行去門口。
say: Thank you, and I will walk straight from this corner to the door.

speaker: tom
text: I have lost my wallet, and I last saw it at the desk this morning.
glossYue: 我唔見咗個銀包，今朝最後一次見係喺櫃檯。
say: I have lost my wallet, and I last saw it at the desk this morning.

speaker: tom
text: Could you help me report it now, because my passport was inside the wallet?
glossYue: 可唔可以而家幫我報失？因為護照喺銀包入面。
say: Could you help me report it now, because my passport was inside the wallet?

speaker: kai
text: The police desk is nearby, and they can write the missing item report for you.
glossYue: 警崗喺附近，佢哋可以幫你寫搵唔到物件嘅報告。
say: The police desk is nearby, and they can write the missing item report for you.

speaker: tom
text: I think the wallet was stolen, so I also need the embassy number.
glossYue: 我諗個銀包畀人偷咗，所以我亦都要大使館電話。
say: I think the wallet was stolen, so I also need the embassy number.

speaker: kai
text: The embassy number is on this card, and I will help you file the report.
glossYue: 大使館電話喺呢張卡上面，我會幫你報失。
say: The embassy number is on this card, and I will help you file the report.

speaker: kai
text: The wallet is still missing, but your passport copies are in the safe.
glossYue: 銀包仲搵唔到，不過護照副本喺夾萬。
say: The wallet is still missing, but your passport copies are in the safe.

speaker: tom
text: I feel faint after the shock, so please tell me if this is an emergency.
glossYue: 我受驚之後覺得暈，唔該話我知係咪緊急。
say: I feel faint after the shock, so please tell me if this is an emergency.

speaker: kai
text: If you feel faint, I can call an ambulance while we file the report.
glossYue: 如果你覺得暈，我可以叫救護車，同時我哋報失。
say: If you feel faint, I can call an ambulance while we file the report.

speaker: mei
text: I am sorry there is an issue, and I will listen before I offer a repair.
glossYue: 唔好意思有問題，我會先聽完先提出修理。
say: I am sorry there is an issue, and I will listen before I offer a repair.

speaker: tom
text: The clasp is broken, so I would like a repair or a full refund today.
glossYue: 個扣壞咗，所以我今日想修理或者全數退款。
say: The clasp is broken, so I would like a repair or a full refund today.

speaker: mei
text: I apologize for the inconvenience, and I understand why you feel disappointed today.
glossYue: 造成不便我道歉，我明白你今日點解唔開心。
say: I apologize for the inconvenience, and I understand why you feel disappointed today.

speaker: tom
text: Could you replace the piece today, and tell me what you can do about it?
glossYue: 今日可唔可以換過呢件，同我講你做到啲咩？
say: Could you replace the piece today, and tell me what you can do about it?

speaker: mei
text: The manager can review the receipt, and we will repair it immediately if the policy allows.
glossYue: 經理可以睇收據，如果政策容許，我哋會即刻修理。
say: The manager can review the receipt, and we will repair it immediately if the policy allows.

speaker: tom
text: I appreciate the offer, but I still want a refund if the repair cannot be done today.
glossYue: 多謝你嘅提議，但如果修理唔到，我今日仍然想退款。
say: I appreciate the offer, but I still want a refund if the repair cannot be done today.

speaker: mei
text: Would it help if we replace the bracelet today, while the workshop keeps the broken one?
glossYue: 如果我哋今日換過條手鏈，工場留住壞嗰條，會唔會好啲？
say: Would it help if we replace the bracelet today, while the workshop keeps the broken one?

speaker: mei
text: I will write the complaint clearly, and you will have an update before the shop closes tonight.
glossYue: 我會寫清楚投訴，舖頭今晚收之前話你知進展。
say: I will write the complaint clearly, and you will have an update before the shop closes tonight.

speaker: ana
text: Are you enjoying the meal so far, and could we get you a cold refill now?
glossYue: 你食到而家開唔開心？我哋可唔可以而家幫你添杯凍嘅？
say: Are you enjoying the meal so far, and could we get you a cold refill now?

speaker: tom
text: Could we get some still water, and one more clean napkin for this fork?
glossYue: 可唔可以嚟杯冇氣水，同埋多一張乾淨餐巾畀呢支叉？
say: Could we get some still water, and one more clean napkin for this fork?

speaker: ana
text: Here is the still water, and the napkin is next to your knife.
glossYue: 冇氣水喺度，餐巾喺你把刀隔離。
say: Here is the still water, and the napkin is next to your knife.

speaker: tom
text: This fish is delicious, and I would like a little more sparkling water.
glossYue: 呢條魚好味，我想要多啲有氣水。
say: This fish is delicious, and I would like a little more sparkling water.

speaker: ana
text: The sparkling water is coming, and I hope you enjoy the rest of it.
glossYue: 有氣水就到，希望你慢慢享受餘下嗰啲。
say: The sparkling water is coming, and I hope you enjoy the rest of it.

speaker: tom
text: No dessert for me, but could we get the bill a little later tonight?
glossYue: 我唔要甜品，不過今晚可唔可以遲啲先埋單？
say: No dessert for me, but could we get the bill a little later tonight?

speaker: ana
text: Of course, and would you like anything else before I leave the table?
glossYue: 當然可以，我離開之前你仲想唔想要其他嘢？
say: Of course, and would you like anything else before I leave the table?

speaker: tom
text: The meal was delicious, and a coffee later would be perfect, thank you.
glossYue: 呢餐好味，遲啲嚟杯咖啡就完美，多謝。
say: The meal was delicious, and a coffee later would be perfect, thank you.

speaker: tom
text: Could we have the bill now, and shall we split it or pay together tonight?
glossYue: 可唔可以而家埋單，今晚分單定係一齊付？
say: Could we have the bill now, and shall we split it or pay together tonight?

speaker: ana
text: We can split it into two separate checks, or you can pay together on one bill.
glossYue: 可以分開兩張單，或者你哋一張單一齊付。
say: We can split it into two separate checks, or you can pay together on one bill.

speaker: tom
text: Please bring the card machine here, and I will pay this check by card.
glossYue: 唔該攞卡機過嚟呢度，我會用卡付呢張單。
say: Please bring the card machine here, and I will pay this check by card.

speaker: ana
text: The card machine is here now, and your receipt will include the service charge.
glossYue: 卡機而家喺度，收據會包括服務費。
say: The card machine is here now, and your receipt will include the service charge.

speaker: tom
text: The service was kind tonight, so I will add a tip and you can keep the change.
glossYue: 今晚服務好好，我會加貼士，零錢你留低就得。
say: The service was kind tonight, so I will add a tip and you can keep the change.

speaker: ana
text: Thank you, and the total does include the service charge before that tip tonight.
glossYue: 多謝，今晚貼士之前個總數已經包括服務費。
say: Thank you, and the total does include the service charge before that tip tonight.

speaker: tom
text: Could we also get the cake as a takeaway before we leave the restaurant tonight?
glossYue: 今晚走之前可唔可以將蛋糕打包外賣？
say: Could we also get the cake as a takeaway before we leave the restaurant tonight?

speaker: ana
text: Here is your takeaway box now, and thank you again for coming in tonight.
glossYue: 外賣盒而家喺度，多謝你哋今晚嚟。
say: Here is your takeaway box now, and thank you again for coming in tonight.

speaker: kai
text: Good morning, this is Kai calling from the harbor office, and how may I help?
glossYue: 早晨，我係海港辦事處嘅 Kai 打嚟，有咩可以幫你？
say: Good morning, this is Kai calling from the harbor office, and how may I help?

speaker: tom
text: Could I speak to Mei regarding the appointment, and may I ask if she is available?
glossYue: 可唔可以同 Mei 講關於個約會，順便問吓佢有冇空？
say: Could I speak to Mei regarding the appointment, and may I ask if she is available?

speaker: kai
text: She is not available right now, so please hold and I will try the other line.
glossYue: 佢而家冇空，唔該等陣，我試吓另一條線。
say: She is not available right now, so please hold and I will try the other line.

speaker: tom
text: Please take a message, and ask her to return my call when it is convenient.
glossYue: 唔該幫我留個言，方便嘅時候叫佢覆我電話。
say: Please take a message, and ask her to return my call when it is convenient.

speaker: kai
text: I will transfer you if the line is free, or I can note the callback number.
glossYue: 如果線路得閒我會轉駁，或者我記低覆電號碼。
say: I will transfer you if the line is free, or I can note the callback number.

speaker: tom
text: Could you say the spelling slowly, and read the extension back to me?
glossYue: 可唔可以慢慢講個串法，再將內線讀返畀我？
say: Could you say the spelling slowly, and read the extension back to me?

speaker: kai
text: The spelling is M E I slowly, and the extension is four two.
glossYue: 我慢慢串 M E I，內線係四二。
say: The spelling is M E I slowly, and the extension is four two.

speaker: tom
text: Thank you for the message, and a callback this afternoon would be convenient.
glossYue: 多謝你幫我留言，今日下晝覆電會方便。
say: Thank you for the message, and a callback this afternoon would be convenient.

speaker: mei
text: Have you kept the receipt with you, and should I explain the warranty before you go?
glossYue: 你有冇帶住張收據？走之前我可唔可以講下保養？
say: Have you kept the receipt with you, and should I explain the warranty before you go?

speaker: tom
text: I have kept the receipt, but a small scratch showed up within the first week.
glossYue: 我有留低收據，但係第一個禮拜就有少少刮痕。
say: I have kept the receipt, but a small scratch showed up within the first week.

speaker: mei
text: You should avoid water and any harsh chemicals, and please use only the soft polish.
glossYue: 你應該避開水同任何勁嘅化學劑，淨係用軟布擦。
say: You should avoid water and any harsh chemicals, and please use only the soft polish.

speaker: tom
text: Does the guarantee cover this new scratch, or should I file a claim within the week?
glossYue: 保養包唔包呢道新刮痕，定係我應該呢個禮拜內申請？
say: Does the guarantee cover this new scratch, or should I file a claim within the week?

speaker: mei
text: The written policy allows one repair within the year if you have kept the receipt.
glossYue: 書面政策容許一年之內修理一次，只要你有留低收據。
say: The written policy allows one repair within the year if you have kept the receipt.

speaker: tom
text: I will avoid harsh chemicals at home and come back later if the polish fails.
glossYue: 我喺屋企會避開勁嘅化學劑，擦唔好就遲啲攞返嚟。
say: I will avoid harsh chemicals at home and come back later if the polish fails.

speaker: mei
text: Please keep that receipt safe, and you should file any new claim within the return window.
glossYue: 請將張收據安全留低，新嘅申請要喺退換期內交。
say: Please keep that receipt safe, and you should file any new claim within the return window.

speaker: tom
text: Thank you, and I now understand the shop policy, the guarantee, and the return window.
glossYue: 多謝，我而家明白舖頭政策、保養同退換期。
say: Thank you, and I now understand the shop policy, the guarantee, and the return window.

speaker: mei
text: You might also like this matching pair, and it completes the look for a birthday gift.
glossYue: 你或者都會鍾意呢對襯到嘅，送生日禮物會成套。
say: You might also like this matching pair, and it completes the look for a birthday gift.

speaker: tom
text: If I am getting the necklace today, do the matching earrings go well with it too?
glossYue: 如果我今日買條頸鏈，對襯嘅耳環會唔會都好配？
say: If I am getting the necklace today, do the matching earrings go well with it too?

speaker: mei
text: Yes, this popular set is optional, and the engraving is a quiet extra on the box.
glossYue: 會，呢套好多人揀，可以唔要，刻字係盒上靜靜嘅加購。
say: Yes, this popular set is optional, and the engraving is a quiet extra on the box.

speaker: tom
text: I like the pair, but I do not need the engraving if the price goes up.
glossYue: 我鍾意呢對，但如果價錢升，我就唔使刻字。
say: I like the pair, but I do not need the engraving if the price goes up.

speaker: mei
text: The engraving is fully optional, and you might also like a simple polish with the set.
glossYue: 刻字完全可以唔要，你或者都會想套裝加一次簡單擦亮。
say: The engraving is fully optional, and you might also like a simple polish with the set.

speaker: tom
text: Please recommend one popular option only, and then I will decide before we leave the shop.
glossYue: 請只推薦一個多人揀嘅選擇，然後我哋走之前我再決定。
say: Please recommend one popular option only, and then I will decide before we leave the shop.

speaker: mei
text: If you like this necklace, the matching pair goes well, and the gift box is ready.
glossYue: 如果你鍾意呢條頸鏈，對襯嘅都好配，禮盒準備好。
say: If you like this necklace, the matching pair goes well, and the gift box is ready.

speaker: tom
text: I will take the matching set without the engraving, and thank you for the gentle offer.
glossYue: 我要呢套襯嘅，唔使刻字，多謝你輕輕咁提議。
say: I will take the matching set without the engraving, and thank you for the gentle offer.

speaker: kai
text: Good evening, this is Kai calling from the front desk, and how may I help you tonight?
glossYue: 晚安，我係前台 Kai 打嚟，今晚有咩可以幫你？
say: Good evening, this is Kai calling from the front desk, and how may I help you tonight?

speaker: tom
text: There seems to be very noisy air conditioning, and I barely slept in this room tonight.
glossYue: 部冷氣似乎好嘈，我今晚喺呢間房幾乎瞓唔到。
say: There seems to be very noisy air conditioning, and I barely slept in this room tonight.

speaker: kai
text: I am sorry for the inconvenience, and I can send an engineer to the noisy room.
glossYue: 造成不便對唔住，我可以派工程師去嗰間嘈房。
say: I am sorry for the inconvenience, and I can send an engineer to the noisy room.

speaker: tom
text: Would it be possible to move us to a quiet room, with extra towels and a blanket?
glossYue: 可唔可以搬我哋去靜啲嘅房，再加多條毛巾同一張被？
say: Would it be possible to move us to a quiet room, with extra towels and a blanket?

speaker: kai
text: A quiet room is available tonight, and I will bring the towels and the blanket now.
glossYue: 今晚有間靜啲嘅房，我而家帶毛巾同被上嚟。
say: A quiet room is available tonight, and I will bring the towels and the blanket now.

speaker: tom
text: The air conditioning is still not working well, so please ask the engineer to check it tonight.
glossYue: 部冷氣仍然唔係好好運作，唔該叫工程師今晚檢查。
say: The air conditioning is still not working well, so please ask the engineer to check it tonight.

speaker: kai
text: I have noted the noisy room already, and the engineer will visit before you sleep tonight.
glossYue: 我已經記低呢間房嘈，工程師你瞓之前會上嚟。
say: I have noted the noisy room already, and the engineer will visit before you sleep tonight.

speaker: tom
text: I appreciate the quiet room, the extra towels, and the warm blanket on this very noisy night.
glossYue: 我感激你安排靜啲嘅房、多條毛巾，同埋呢晚嘅暖被。
say: I appreciate the quiet room, the extra towels, and the warm blanket on this very noisy night.

speaker: kai
text: Good morning Tom, I am following up today on the email I have sent regarding the deadline.
glossYue: 早晨 Tom，我今日跟進我已經寄出、關於期限嗰封電郵。
say: Good morning Tom, I am following up today on the email I have sent regarding the deadline.

speaker: tom
text: Thank you for following up, and I am grateful that you have attached the notes as discussed.
glossYue: 多謝你跟進，我感激你按討論咁附上筆記。
say: Thank you for following up, and I am grateful that you have attached the notes as discussed.

speaker: kai
text: I have attached the file as discussed, and I would like to clarify the deadline with you.
glossYue: 我已經按討論附上份文件，想同你講清楚個期限。
say: I have attached the file as discussed, and I would like to clarify the deadline with you.

speaker: tom
text: Could you please clarify the deadline, and would it be possible to confirm a new time today?
glossYue: 可唔可以講清楚個期限，同埋今日確認一個新時間？
say: Could you please clarify the deadline, and would it be possible to confirm a new time today?

speaker: kai
text: I propose Friday for the new deadline, and I can confirm the time once you are available.
glossYue: 我提議星期五做新期限，你有空我就確認時間。
say: I propose Friday for the new deadline, and I can confirm the time once you are available.

speaker: tom
text: I am available on Friday, and I have already looked at the file you attached this morning.
glossYue: 我星期五有空，我已經睇過你今朝附上嘅文件。
say: I am available on Friday, and I have already looked at the file you attached this morning.

speaker: kai
text: I am grateful for the quick reply, and I will confirm the Friday deadline in writing.
glossYue: 我感激你咁快覆，我會書面確認星期五個期限。
say: I am grateful for the quick reply, and I will confirm the Friday deadline in writing.

speaker: tom
text: Best regards for now, and I look forward to the note once you confirm the deadline.
glossYue: 暫時祝好，你確認期限之後我期待你份筆記。
say: Best regards for now, and I look forward to the note once you confirm the deadline.

speaker: kai
text: Good morning everyone, let's open the meeting now and share a short update on the agenda today.
glossYue: 早晨各位，我哋而家開會，分享今日議程上一個短更新。
say: Good morning everyone, let's open the meeting now and share a short update on the agenda today.

speaker: tom
text: The update is that the deadline moved, and I am concerned we may miss the action item today.
glossYue: 更新係期限改咗，我擔心我哋今日完成唔到呢項行動。
say: The update is that the deadline moved, and I am concerned we may miss the action item today.

speaker: kai
text: Could you please expand on the deadline, and could you unmute so we can hear the update?
glossYue: 可唔可以再講多啲個期限，同埋開返咪等我哋聽到更新？
say: Could you please expand on the deadline, and could you unmute so we can hear the update?

speaker: tom
text: I see your point, but I am concerned the owner cannot meet this new deadline on Friday.
glossYue: 我明白你嘅意思，但係我擔心負責人星期五趕唔切呢個新期限。
say: I see your point, but I am concerned the owner cannot meet this new deadline on Friday.

speaker: kai
text: Let's agree on Friday, and the owner can share the next update before we wrap up.
glossYue: 我哋同意星期五，負責人收會之前可以分享下一個更新。
say: Let's agree on Friday, and the owner can share the next update before we wrap up.

text: I agree with Friday, but I suggest we mute the side chat and stay on the agenda now.

say: I agree with Friday, but I suggest we mute the side chat and stay on the agenda now.

speaker: tom
text: I have had a fever and cough since Monday, and my sore throat feels worse.

text: Do you have a headache too, and do you have an allergy to this medicine?

text: I have had a headache since Monday, and I have no allergy to this medicine.

glossYue: 你可以喺屋企休息，藥房今日可以幫你配呢張藥單。

text: I will take the prescription to the pharmacy, and I need a follow-up after rest.
glossYue: 我會帶藥單去藥房，休息之後要覆診。

text: I can block the lost card, but I need your ID and a signed form.
glossYue: 我可以凍結張唔見咗嘅卡，但係我要你嘅身份證明同一張簽好嘅表格。
